findings.highlight: dulls her silver hair and red eyes
findings.evidenceJa: 赤い瞳に影を落としていた
findings.governingReading: Gray sunlight dulls Illya’s silver hair and casts shadow across her red eyes.
findings.explanation: The English merges two distinct optical effects and omits the shadow.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=イリヤスフィール char=5]銀髪の少女
findings.governingReading: The surface calls her the silver-haired girl while the ruby names Illyasviel.
findings.explanation: The English keeps only the name.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=テンノサカズキ char=3]大空洞
findings.governingReading: The Great Cavern bears the ruby “Cup of Heaven.”
findings.explanation: The English mistranslates the proper place as a giant cavern and loses the ruby name.

findings.evidenceJa: 起動が始まってる
findings.governingReading: Activation has already begun.
findings.explanation: The English changes an unfolding process into a completed state.

findings.highlight: the rules of the Holy Grail War
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争という[ruby text=ルール char=2]儀式
findings.governingReading: The written text calls the Grail War a ritual while the ruby reads rules.
findings.explanation: The English retains rules and erases the ritual layer.

findings.highlight: its contents to come out before the gate had been opened
findings.evidenceJa: 開けてもいないのに中に棲んでしまうモノ
findings.governingReading: Something has taken up residence inside the Grail even though the gate has not been opened.
findings.explanation: The English reverses inward occupation into contents emerging outward.

findings.evidenceJa: 滑稽ね
findings.governingReading: Illya calls the founders’ outcome absurd or ridiculous.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes an emotional state of disbelief for her judgment.

findings.evidenceJa: 今から調停に赴いたところで
findings.governingReading: Even if Illya went now to mediate or arbitrate, she believes she could not close it.
findings.explanation: The English removes the specific intervention she considers.

findings.highlight: Matou Sakura excels her in ability as the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯としての能力は、いまや間桐桜が勝っている
findings.governingReading: Sakura now surpasses Illya in capacity or ability as a Grail.
findings.explanation: The English uses malformed “excels her” and blurs the comparison.

findings.evidenceJa: 違うモノを開いた
findings.governingReading: Zouken intended the same thing but opened something different.
findings.explanation: The English adds total difference.

findings.highlight: the girl sitting at the porch
findings.evidenceJa: 中庭で佇む少女の肩
findings.governingReading: Sakura reaches slowly toward the shoulder of Illya standing in the courtyard.
findings.explanation: The English relocates Illya to the porch, makes her sit, and omits the shoulder target.

findings.evidenceJa: 間桐桜の腕が止まる
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s whole arm stops when Rin speaks.
findings.explanation: The English narrows the arrested motion to her hand.

findings.evidenceJa: 二人の対峙を傍観する
findings.governingReading: Illya moves aside as a detached observer of the sisters’ confrontation.
findings.explanation: “Watch over” adds a protective supervisory role.

findings.evidenceJa: イリヤちゃんを誘いに来る
findings.governingReading: Sakura says she came to invite Illya.
findings.explanation: The English anticipates Rin’s hostile interpretation and removes Sakura’s euphemistic framing.

findings.highlight: You always make fun of me
findings.evidenceJa: そうやって極め付けて、わたしを馬鹿にする
findings.governingReading: Sakura accuses Rin of categorically deciding what she is and then mocking her.
findings.explanation: The English omits the imposed judgment.

findings.highlight: the person that Matou Sakura wanted to protect
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐桜を守りたがってたヤツ
findings.governingReading: Rin condemns Sakura for failing to trust the person who wanted to protect Matou Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English reverses the desire, making Sakura the would-be protector.

findings.highlight: the same mistake you always made
findings.evidenceJa: 今までとまったく同じ失敗
findings.governingReading: Sakura repeats exactly the same kind of failure as before.
findings.explanation: The English turns recurrence into an absolute habitual claim.

findings.evidenceJa: 僅かに後退してしまった
findings.governingReading: Rin involuntarily retreats slightly.
findings.explanation: The English enlarges the brief movement into a full step.

findings.evidenceJa: その焦り
findings.governingReading: Rin’s alarm or panic at the shadow emboldens Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English changes anxious urgency into indecision.

findings.highlight: a swordsman who is contaminated in black
findings.evidenceJa: 黒く汚染された剣の騎士
findings.governingReading: The black-corrupted Knight of the Sword crawls from Sakura’s shadow.
findings.explanation: The English loses the class-bearing knight title, genders the figure male, and uses malformed color phrasing.

findings.highlight: go as rough as you like
findings.evidenceJa: 多少の乱暴は構わない
findings.governingReading: Sakura permits some limited roughness only if Illya resists.
findings.explanation: The English removes the limit on force.

findings.highlight: a Servant swallowed by the mud
findings.evidenceJa: あの影に呑まれたサーヴァント
findings.governingReading: Rin sees what happens to a Servant swallowed by the shadow.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes mud for the consuming entity.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂凛という魔術回路
findings.governingReading: Rin is figured as the Magic Circuit called Tohsaka Rin, helpless before absorption.
findings.explanation: The English removes the technical identity metaphor.

findings.evidenceJa: 間桐桜が保有する“魔術”
findings.governingReading: Rin recognizes the tendrils as magecraft Sakura herself possesses.
findings.explanation: The English uses generic magic and awkward possession.

findings.evidenceJa: 今の桜の魔力は無尽蔵
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s present reserves are effectively inexhaustible.
findings.explanation: The English converts practical bottomlessness into literal infinity.

findings.highlight: Even a Servant will not be able to match
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントを以ってしても打倒しうるかどうか
findings.governingReading: Rin doubts whether even a Servant could defeat such an extraordinary magus.
findings.explanation: The English promotes uncertainty into categorical inability and weakens defeat to matching.

findings.highlight: she doesn’t have such a thing
findings.evidenceJa: そんなものは出来ていない
findings.governingReading: An equivalent magical-energy supply is not prepared or completed.
findings.explanation: The English changes readiness into Rin simply not possessing one.

findings.evidenceJa: 唇を歪め
findings.governingReading: Sakura twists her lips in absolute dominance.
findings.explanation: The English normalizes the malicious expression into a smile.

findings.evidenceJa: それまで可愛く逃げてくださいね
findings.governingReading: Sakura taunts her beloved sister to flee cutely until capture.
findings.explanation: The English omits the infantilizing “cutely.”

findings.evidenceJa: 一息のうちに中庭はおろか屋敷の全てを覆い尽くせる
findings.governingReading: Sakura could cover not merely the courtyard but the entire house in a single breath.
findings.explanation: The English loses the courtyard escalation and exact speed.

findings.evidenceJa: 凛の内臓をドロドロに侵していく
findings.governingReading: The mud churns through Rin and corrodes or invades her organs into slurry.
findings.explanation: The English sexualizes the action while obscuring its physical corrosion.

findings.evidenceJa: 苦しげに吐息を漏らす
findings.governingReading: Rin hangs her head and lets out a pained breath.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the audible breath with chest movement.

findings.highlight: Sakura is firmly convinced that she will lose
findings.evidenceJa: 自分が殺されると桜は確信する
findings.governingReading: Sakura irrationally believes Rin will kill her in their next fight.
findings.explanation: The English removes the death stake and reduces it to defeat.

findings.highlight: just as Rin tried to do to her
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂凛がそうするように
findings.governingReading: Sakura tells herself to act as she imagines Rin would act.
findings.explanation: The English invents a prior attempt by Rin to kill Sakura.

findings.evidenceJa: 掌を広げる
findings.governingReading: Sakura opens one palm to issue the killing attack.
findings.explanation: The English pluralizes the gesture.
